summary: Ferroglobe PLC filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, containing a press release announcing second quarter 2026 financial results and an accompanying earnings presentation. The filing reports sales of $378.6 million, adjusted EBITDA of $13.1 million, and a net profit of $60.4 million. It also mentions a quarterly dividend of $0.015 per share paid on June 30 and another payable on September 29. This is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation event, such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review. The filing is solely for informational purposes and incorporation into registration statements.
